ablation: Remove defining conditioning transform as specified, preserving gate, validity, schedule and direct-score allocator.
allocation: Each selected name gets min(0.25,1/top_k)*clip(score,0,1). No renormalization. Strength survives construction; weak signal capacity stays cash.
cash_rule: Missing state, no positive scores, or nonpositive 63-day sum of eligible equal-market log returns means no new allocation.
code_sha: Captured in immutable premeasurement implementation freeze and evaluator context
contamination_notes: 2016–2022 repeatedly reused across A–D; public 2024–2025 examples already read. Any later chronological test is forward diagnostic, not pristine holdout. Live is never used.
cost_hypothesis: Weekly targets, bounded confidence sizing and cash reduce unnecessary exposure; exact cost ladder decides economics.
failure_mode: OHLCV proxy or response curve duplicates ordinary risk/trend; liquidity/quantile estimates unstable; events sparse; execution too slow.
portfolio_role: Unpromoted research satellite; require incremental value against matched controls and incumbents.
primitive: Quantiacs cryptodaily OHLCV and historical is_liquid only
rebalance: Monday only; eligibility/invalid-close exits remain closed until next Monday; gross gate sets scheduled targets, not daily unscheduled exits.
selection: Positive bounded score, top_k with deterministic sorted-label tie breaking.
selection_objective: minimum research/dev Sharpe at 4/8/12% ATR costs; existing tie breakers; no promotion from research alone
source_notes: Original hypothesis development from repository frontier and unimplemented ideas; no external performance claims or newly admitted datasets.
stop_rule: Frozen existing family adjudication: central ablation/falsifier matching/beating base freezes family; every base below 1.0 freezes weak alpha; no post-return grid expansion.
thesis: Expected multi-day displacement must exceed a predeclared ATR-linked round-trip cost before entry.
timing: Completed t bars; conditioning estimates through t-1; toolbox owns execution lag.
transform: Positive preceding W-day residual mean times five minus 2*0.12*ATR14/close; scale positive surplus by ATR14/close, cap at one. Ablate hurdle; rotate cost among eligible peers as falsifier.
universe: Historical is_liquid == 1; valid positive finite close; current eligible observations alone form peer market and permutations.
